dedupe_keys.name: the 2018 national seismic hazard assessment for australia data

description: The 2018 National Seismic Hazard Assessment for Australia – Data is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This data is the output from the model assessment for the 2018 National Seismic Hazard Assessment for Australia (NSHA18) product (refer eCat 123020 for overview of product). This data is provided in multiple formats and is supported by accompanying maps to illustrate the seismic hazard (refer description of the model output at eCat 123028). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are HVC_144647, Published_External. It offers 2 resource(s) in html, zip. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
